title: The Wedding Card
intro: A wedding invitation arrives in a chat from a number you do not know. It is a file, not a picture.
Tap anything that looks odd to sniff it closer. Pin what is suspicious, clear what is harmless.
When you are sure, decide what to do.

notify.text: You are invited to our wedding 💍 Download the card…

msg: Namaste! 🙏 You are warmly invited to our
Please download the card to see the date and venue:

msg.text: Open it and tap "Install" to view.
Do forward it to your family and friends too!

file.label: An app file, not a card
file.lens: ".apk" is an app installer, not a picture or a PDF. A wedding card does not need an app.
file.why: Never install an app that arrives as a file in a chat.

unknown.label: A stranger
unknown.lens: The number is not in your contacts.
unknown.why: Be careful with files from numbers you do not know.

open.label: "Tap Install"
open.lens: To "view" the card you must install something on your phone.
open.why: Viewing a card never needs installing. The install is the attack.

tell.label: "Forward to everyone"
tell.lens: It asks you to forward the file to your contacts.
tell.why: Scam apps spread by making you send them on.

sender.label: An Indian mobile number
sender.why: A number proves nothing either way.

wedding.label: A wedding invitation
wedding.lens: A friendly, ordinary reason to write.
wedding.why: The story is believable. That is why it works.

actions.label: Ask the family on a number I already know

trap.title: Install unknown app?
trap.ask: This app wants to read your messages and show over other apps. Allow installing from this source?

block_report.line: Deleted and reported. Your phone company can now block more of these messages.

verify.line: You rang your cousin. No wedding, no invitation, and the same file had reached half the family. Case cracked.

ignore.line: You stayed safe. But the same scam is still landing on other people.

go_ahead.line: The app read your messages and codes, then used your payment apps. Your bank account was emptied.

what_if.go_ahead: A wedding card is a picture or a PDF. Any card that needs an app is an attack. Calling someone you know takes a minute.
what_if.ignore: Reporting takes two taps and helps protect other people.
what_if.verify: Checking was smart. Reporting it as well helps protect other people.

golden_rule: Never install an app from a file in a chat. A real card is a picture or a PDF.

quick_check.q: A chat from an unknown number sends "WeddingInvite.apk" and asks you to install it. What do you do?

options.text: Install it, it is only a card
Install it but do not give permissions
Do not open it. Delete it and report the message
Forward it to family so they can see it

quick_check.explain: An app file in a chat is never a card. Real apps come from the official app store.

hints.nudge: What kind of file is a "card" that ends in .apk?

rows.v: Only the official app store or a trusted site
